patches.subject: build: skip empty generator dependencies
patches.reason: Inherited generator compatibility: an unset kernel path must not become an invalid dependency.

patches.subject: build: support prebuilt kernel header archives
patches.reason: Inherited prerequisite for the generated kernel header provider; keep source/archive selection compatible.

patches.subject: build: support unpacked prebuilt kernel headers
patches.reason: Annibale exports a flat UAPI tree. Declare each sandbox output and cleanup dependency, use absolute cleanup paths, and quote the unused archive branch. Selected by TARGET_PREBUILT_KERNEL_HEADER_DIR; other paths keep existing selection.

patches.subject: fix(telephony): recognize advanced NR signals
patches.reason: Consume modem advanced-icon hints through normal carrier policy; also normalize Motorola NR_CA registration. The Qualcomm adapter cannot alter private display policy from the device tree alone.

patches.subject: fix(phone): request Qualcomm telephony access
patches.reason: The phone process must explicitly request the Qualcomm service permission. Device resource overlays cannot add application uses-permission declarations.
